headline: Eskom Proposes 8.84% Municipal Electricity Tariff Hike for July 2027
summary: Eskom requested permission to raise electricity charges for municipalities by 8.84% starting July 2027, with the energy regulator set to decide on municipal tariff deadlines.
why: Utility price adjustments directly impact municipal operating costs and consumer energy bills, influencing inflation and industrial overhead.

impacts.name: Utilities
impacts.why: Higher tariff approvals increase revenue generation for power providers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
